_comment: Transcribed from an in-game screenshot taken 2026-08-01 (Steam capture index 119 in the 16:03 run). Gadget screens carry a name, a model designation and a description but no stat block or trait chips, so this item has no stats or ratings. Art is cropped from the same shot. The page leads with the model designation because that is what EA's patch notes use.
name: M18 Smoke Grenade

description.text: A grenade designed to create temporary smoke screens. Blocks ability to spot targets and clears spotted markers from all infantry inside the smoke radius.
